partialCoverage.note: Contains 20 poems (Poema I–XX in Migne's numbering, 24,491 words). Five poems (Poema I–II to Gestidius, Poema III De regibus ex Suetonio, and Poema X–XI Ausonio Paulinus) are present in Perseus under Ausonius's Epistularum (stoa0045.stoa011.perseus-lat2, Ep. 28–31), and Poema IV (Ad Deum matutina precatio) is an excerpt of Ausonius's Ephemeris (stoa0045.stoa008.perseus-lat2, 3.1–19). The other 14 poems (Poema V–IX and XII–XX, including the Natalitia for St. Felix and Ad Nicetam) are missing from Perseus.

Several of the verse poems are also in Hypotactic (hypotactic:petronius.json:Petronius, 'Other Poems').
